meta.name: affinda-automation
meta.description: Automate Affinda tasks via Rube MCP (Composio). Always search tools first for current schemas.

copy.tagline: 自动通过 Rube MCP 处理 Affinda 文档解析任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要自动化处理 Affinda 文档解析任务
copy.tagline_en: Automate Affinda document parsing tasks via Rube MCP
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate Affinda document data extraction

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可通过 Rube MCP 调用 Affinda 工具，例如解析简历或提取文档数据。它会先搜索可用工具、检查连接，再执行任务。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 处理 Affinda 任务（如解析简历、提取联系人）且 Rube MCP 已连接、Affinda 账户已激活时触发。

say.text: 用 Affinda 解析这份简历
say.note: Claude 会自动搜索工具并执行。

say.text: 提取这个文档中的联系人字段
say.note: Claude 会调用 Affinda 的提取工具。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can invoke Affinda tools via Rube MCP, such as parsing resumes or extracting document data. It will first search for available tools, check the connection, then execute the task.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to handle an Affinda task (e.g., parse a resume, extract contacts) and Rube MCP is connected with an active Affinda account.

say_en.note: Claude will auto-discover tools and run.

say_en.text: Extract contact fields from this document
say_en.note: Claude will use Affinda's extraction tool.
